---
name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve workflow JSON or documentation accuracy
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug or documentation inconsistency is.

**Workflow ID & Name**
- Workflow ID: (e.g. `05-01`)
- Workflow Name: (e.g. `Intelligent Lead Routing & Scoring`)

**Expected Behavior**
What was expected to happen when importing or evaluating the workflow.

**Observed Behavior**
What actually happened (e.g., node syntax error, broken link, schema mismatch).

**Environment**
- n8n Version: (e.g., v1.50.0)
- Node OS/Hosting: (e.g., Cloud / Docker / Self-Hosted)
